title: Israel Open Data (data.gov.il) input
description: Search the data.gov.il catalogue or fetch records from a specific datastore resource. Records come back as clean JSON with English keys.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: search_datasets: find datasets/resources by keyword. fetch_records: pull rows from one datastore resource (needs resourceId).

query.title: Query
query.description: Free-text search. In search_datasets it searches dataset titles/descriptions (Hebrew or English). In fetch_records it is a full-text filter over the records (CKAN 'q').

resourceId.title: Resource ID
resourceId.description: UUID of the datastore resource (from search_datasets output, or from the data.gov.il resource page URL). Required in fetch_records mode.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Exact-match filters as a JSON object, using the ORIGINAL (Hebrew) column names, e.g. {"סטטוס חברה": "פעילה"}. Values may be a string or an array of strings.

maxRecords.title: Max records
maxRecords.description: Maximum number of records (fetch_records) or datasets (search_datasets) to return. You are charged only for what is returned.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Skip this many records before returning results (for manual pagination between runs).

translateFields.title: Translate field names to English
translateFields.description: Map common Hebrew column names (מספר חברה, שם עמותה, ...) to snake_case English keys. Unknown columns keep their original name. The full mapping used is saved to the key-value store as FIELD_MAP.

coerceTypes.title: Coerce types
coerceTypes.description: Convert numeric/date/boolean columns to proper JSON types based on the datastore field metadata, and empty strings to null.

outputFormat.title: Output format
outputFormat.description: json: one dataset item per record. csv: additionally writes OUTPUT.csv to the key-value store (English headers when translateFields is on).

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: CKAN sort expression using ORIGINAL column names, e.g. "תאריך התאגדות desc". Optional.

pageSize.title: Page size
pageSize.description: Advanced: records per API request (1-1000). Lower it if the portal times out on wide tables.

baseUrl.title: CKAN base URL
baseUrl.description: Advanced: another CKAN 2.x portal. Defaults to https://data.gov.il.
